<![CDATA[import type { Metadata, Viewport } from "next";
import { DM_Mono, Plus_Jakarta_Sans, Space_Mono } from "next/font/google";
import { NULO_MOTION_SCRIPT } from "./nulo/motion/mode";
import "./nulo/nulo.css";

const display = DM_Mono({ subsets: ["latin"], weight: ["400", "500"], variable: "--font-dm-mono" });
const body = Plus_Jakarta_Sans({ subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-jakarta" });
const mono = Space_Mono({ subsets: ["latin"], weight: ["400", "700"], variable: "--font-space-mono" });

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "NULO — tune your view",
  description: "A modular optical lab that calibrates prescription frames for the way your day actually moves.",
};

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  themeColor: "#F5F8F4",
  colorScheme: "light",
};

export default function NuloLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`${display.variable} ${body.variable} ${mono.variable}`} suppressHydrationWarning>
      <body className="nu-body">
        <script
          type={typeof window === "undefined" ? "text/javascript" : "text/plain"}
          suppressHydrationWarning
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: NULO_MOTION_SCRIPT }}
        />
        <noscript>
          <style>{`[data-nu-reveal]{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;clip-path:none!important}`}</style>
        </noscript>
        {children}
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(nulo)/nulo/assets.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";

const BASE = "/templates/nulo";

export function assetSrc(key: string, width: 800 | 1600, format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp"): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

export function Picture({ assetKey, alt, className }: { assetKey: string; alt: string; className?: string }) {
  const source = assetSrc(assetKey, 800);
  if (!source) {
    return <div className={`nu-placeholder ${className ?? ""}`} role="img" aria-label={alt} data-asset={assetKey}><span className="nu-mono">{assetKey}</span></div>;
  }
  const { w, h } = ASSETS[assetKey];
  return <img className={className} src={source} srcSet={`${source} 800w, ${assetSrc(assetKey, 1600)} 1600w`} sizes="(min-width: 900px) 50vw, 100vw" width={w} height={h} alt={alt} loading="lazy" decoding="async" />;
}
]]>

<![CDATA[@import "tailwindcss";

@theme {
  --color-nulo-paper: #F5F8F4;
  --color-nulo-ink: #14232B;
  --color-nulo-lilac: #B8B3FF;
  --color-nulo-peach: #FFB49D;
  --color-nulo-mint: #9ADBD1;
  --font-nulo-display: var(--font-dm-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;
  --font-nulo-body: var(--font-jakarta), system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-nulo-mono: var(--font-space-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;
  --ease-nulo-out: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
  --ease-nulo-in-out: cubic-bezier(.65, 0, .35, 1);
  --ease-nulo-spring: linear(0, .38 9%, .88 22%, 1.04 34%, 1.01 48%, .995 66%, 1);
  --dur-nulo-instant: 90ms;
  --dur-nulo-fast: 180ms;
  --dur-nulo-base: 420ms;
  --dur-nulo-slow: 820ms;
  --dur-nulo-hero: 1200ms;
  --nulo-shift: 28px;
  --nulo-stagger: 80ms;
}

:root {
  --nulo-paper: #F5F8F4;
  --nulo-ink: #14232B;
  --nulo-lilac: #B8B3FF;
  --nulo-peach: #FFB49D;
  --nulo-mint: #9ADBD1;
  --nu-scroll: 0;
  --nu-progress: 0%;
  color-scheme: light;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; background: var(--nulo-paper); }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--nulo-paper); color: var(--nulo-ink); }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
button, a { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
a { color: inherit; }

.nu-body {
  overflow-x: hidden;
  font-family: var(--font-jakarta), system-ui, sans-serif;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 5%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 42px 42px,
    linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 5%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 42px 42px,
    var(--nulo-paper);
}

.nu-shell { position: relative; isolation: isolate; }
.nu-shell::before {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: .24;
  z-index: -1;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 18% 12%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 28%, transparent), transparent 32%), radial-gradient(circle at 84% 46%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 20%, transparent), transparent 34%);
}

.nu-skip { position: fixed; left: 16px; top: 14px; z-index: 100; transform: translateY(-160%); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--nulo-ink); color: var(--nulo-paper); padding: 10px 14px; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 11px; transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-fast) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-skip:focus { transform: translateY(0); }

.nu-mono { font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 10px; }
.nu-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 68%, transparent); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; }
.nu-eyebrow::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 22px; height: 1px; background: var(--nulo-peach); }
.nu-display { font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; letter-spacing: -.07em; }
.nu-muted { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 61%, transparent); }

.nu-header { position: fixed; inset: 0 0 auto; z-index: 50; height: 76px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 12%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 86%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-out), background var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-header__inner { width: min(1280px, calc(100% - 48px)); height: 100%; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; }
.nu-header__nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; margin-left: auto; }
.nu-header__link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 70%, transparent); transition: color var(--dur-nulo-fast) ease; }
.nu-header__link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -7px; height: 2px; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; background: var(--nulo-peach); transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-header__link:hover, .nu-header__link:focus-visible { color: var(--nulo-ink); }
.nu-header__link:hover::after, .nu-header__link:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
.nu-header__link--active::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--nulo-mint); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 26%, transparent); }
.nu-header__cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--nulo-ink); border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 15px; background: var(--nulo-ink); color: var(--nulo-paper); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-fast) var(--ease-nulo-spring), background var(--dur-nulo-fast) ease; }
.nu-header__cta::after { content: "↗"; color: var(--nulo-peach); font-size: 14px; line-height: 0; }
.nu-header__cta:hover, .nu-header__cta:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-2px); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 88%, var(--nulo-lilac)); }
.nu-header__menu { display: none; width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 22%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; }
.nu-header__progress { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; transform-origin: left; transform: scaleX(var(--nu-scroll)); background: var(--nulo-peach); }
.nu-header__nav[data-open="true"] { display: flex; }

.nu-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; }
.nu-logo__mark { width: 31px; height: 31px; color: var(--nulo-ink); overflow: visible; }
.nu-logo__word { font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: -.06em; }
.nu-logo__dot { color: var(--nulo-peach); }

.nu-main { position: relative; }
.nu-hero { position: relative; min-height: 100svh; padding: 136px 0 92px; overflow: clip; }
.nu-hero__inner { width: min(1280px, calc(100% - 48px)); min-height: calc(100svh - 170px); margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, .75fr) minmax(520px, 1.25fr); align-items: center; gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 110px); }
.nu-hero__copy { position: relative; z-index: 2; padding-bottom: 30px; }
.nu-hero__title { max-width: 580px; margin: 18px 0 22px; font-size: clamp(54px, 7.6vw, 118px); line-height: .91; font-weight: 500; }
.nu-hero__title em { display: inline-block; padding: 0 .14em .06em; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--nulo-lilac); font-style: normal; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); }
.nu-hero__lede { max-width: 390px; margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 68%, transparent); font-size: clamp(15px, 1.45vw, 19px); line-height: 1.6; }
.nu-hero__actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-top: 34px; }
.nu-button { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--nulo-ink); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 20px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-fast) var(--ease-nulo-spring), color var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-out), background var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-button::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: translateX(-101%); background: var(--nulo-peach); transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-button > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.nu-button:hover::before, .nu-button:focus-visible::before { transform: translateX(0); }
.nu-button:hover, .nu-button:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-2px); color: var(--nulo-ink); }
.nu-button:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); }
.nu-button--dark { background: var(--nulo-ink); color: var(--nulo-paper); }
.nu-button--dark::before { background: var(--nulo-lilac); }
.nu-button--ghost { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 62%, transparent); }
.nu-button__arrow { font-size: 17px; line-height: 0; transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-button:hover .nu-button__arrow, .nu-button:focus-visible .nu-button__arrow { transform: translate(3px, -3px); }
.nu-hero__note { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-top: 20px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 56%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.nu-hero__note i { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--nulo-mint); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 26%, transparent); }
.nu-hero__rail { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 26px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 54%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.nu-hero__rail::before, .nu-hero__rail::after { content: ""; width: 28px; height: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 24%, transparent); }
.nu-hero__rail-logo { display: none; }

.nu-hero__instrument { position: relative; min-height: 600px; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.nu-hero__instrument::before { content: ""; position: absolute; width: min(47vw, 640px); aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 13%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(calc(var(--nu-scroll) * -9deg)); }
.nu-hero__instrument::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: min(35vw, 480px); aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 18%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(calc(var(--nu-scroll) * 12deg)); }
.nu-instrument-label { position: absolute; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 62%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-instrument-label::before { content: ""; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--nulo-peach); }
.nu-instrument-label--top { top: 6%; right: 7%; }
.nu-instrument-label--bottom { bottom: 3%; left: 8%; }

.nu-dial { --nu-angle: 0deg; --nu-aperture: .58; position: relative; z-index: 1; width: min(42vw, 560px); aspect-ratio: 1; touch-action: none; user-select: none; cursor: grab; perspective: 1000px; }
.nu-dial:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.nu-dial__shadow { position: absolute; left: 12%; right: 12%; bottom: 5%; height: 17%; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 15%, transparent); filter: blur(18px); transform: translateY(calc(var(--nu-scroll) * 16px)); }
.nu-dial__face { position: absolute; inset: 7%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 26%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 76%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 11px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 52%, transparent), 0 22px 42px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 10%, transparent); transform: rotateX(10deg) rotateZ(calc(var(--nu-scroll) * 3deg)); transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-slow) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-dial__face::before, .nu-dial__face::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 10%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 14%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; }
.nu-dial__face::after { inset: 24%; border-style: dashed; transform: rotate(22deg); }
.nu-dial__ring { position: absolute; inset: 17%; border: 2px solid var(--nulo-ink); border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(var(--nu-angle)); transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-spring); }
.nu-dial__ring::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -16px; width: 3px; height: 31px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--nulo-peach); transform: translateX(-50%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-peach) 22%, transparent); }
.nu-dial__ring::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -4px; top: 50%; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--nulo-ink); transform: translateY(-50%); }
.nu-dial__ticks { position: absolute; inset: 8%; border-radius: 50%; background: repeating-conic-gradient(from -1deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 56%, transparent) 0deg 1deg, transparent 1deg 12deg); mask: radial-gradient(transparent 0 86%, var(--nulo-ink) 86.4% 87.2%, transparent 87.6%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(transparent 0 86%, var(--nulo-ink) 86.4% 87.2%, transparent 87.6%); opacity: .62; }
.nu-dial__lens { position: absolute; inset: 25%; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 32%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 36% 32%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 76%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 64%, transparent) 48%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 13%, transparent)); box-shadow: inset -18px -12px 32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 14%, transparent), inset 13px 14px 28px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 76%, transparent); transform: rotate(calc(var(--nu-angle) * -.35)) scale(calc(.93 + var(--nu-aperture) * .1)); transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-spring), background var(--dur-nulo-slow) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-dial__lens::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 14%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 58%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; }
.nu-dial__lens::after { content: ""; width: 24%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 42%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 38%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 20%, transparent); }
.nu-dial__crosshair { position: absolute; inset: 42%; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 45%, transparent); border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 45%, transparent); transform: rotate(calc(var(--nu-angle) * .5)); transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-spring); }
.nu-dial__readout { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 16%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 9px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 18%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 82%, transparent); white-space: nowrap; }
.nu-dial__readout strong { font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-dial__readout span { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 55%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; }
.nu-dial__mode-buttons { position: absolute; bottom: -36px; left: 50%; display: flex; gap: 6px; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.nu-mode-button { border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; padding: 6px 7px; background: transparent; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 54%, transparent); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .11em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color var(--dur-nulo-fast) ease, border-color var(--dur-nulo-fast) ease; }
.nu-mode-button:hover, .nu-mode-button:focus-visible, .nu-mode-button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--nulo-ink); border-color: var(--nulo-peach); }
.nu-dial__hint { position: absolute; right: 8%; bottom: 5%; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 50%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .05em; }

.nu-band { position: relative; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 15%, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 15%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 26%, var(--nulo-paper)); overflow: hidden; }
.nu-band__inner { width: min(1280px, calc(100% - 48px)); min-height: 80px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; }
.nu-band__ticker { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; white-space: nowrap; animation: nu-ticker 26s linear infinite; }
.nu-band:hover .nu-band__ticker, .nu-band:focus-within .nu-band__ticker { animation-play-state: paused; }
.nu-band__item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-band__item::before { content: "✳"; color: var(--nulo-peach); font-size: 14px; }

.nu-section { position: relative; padding: clamp(88px, 12vw, 170px) 0; }
.nu-section--ink { color: var(--nulo-paper); background: var(--nulo-ink); }
.nu-section--ink::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: .3; background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 12%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 48px 48px, linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 12%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 48px 48px; }
.nu-container { width: min(1280px, calc(100% - 48px)); margin: 0 auto; }
.nu-section__head { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 32px; margin-bottom: clamp(42px, 6vw, 76px); }
.nu-section__title { max-width: 720px; margin: 18px 0 0; font-size: clamp(42px, 6.5vw, 92px); line-height: .93; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.08em; }
.nu-section__intro { max-width: 290px; margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 62%, transparent); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }
.nu-grid { display: grid; gap: 18px; }

.nu-calibration { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-peach) 19%, var(--nulo-paper)); }
.nu-calibration__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, .72fr) minmax(460px, 1.28fr); gap: clamp(44px, 8vw, 130px); align-items: center; }
.nu-calibration__copy h2 { max-width: 560px; margin: 16px 0 22px; font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: clamp(42px, 5.4vw, 82px); line-height: .94; letter-spacing: -.08em; font-weight: 500; }
.nu-calibration__copy p { max-width: 430px; margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 66%, transparent); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; }
.nu-calibration__notes { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin-top: 32px; }
.nu-calibration__note { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.nu-calibration__note-index { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 25px; height: 25px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 28%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; }
.nu-calibration__note p { margin: 1px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .03em; line-height: 1.45; }
.nu-signal { position: relative; min-height: 440px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 17%, transparent); border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; overflow: hidden; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 55%, transparent); }
.nu-signal::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 16px; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 18%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; }
.nu-signal__grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: .7; background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 12%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 42px 42px, linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 12%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 42px 42px; mask: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--nulo-ink), transparent 86%); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--nulo-ink), transparent 86%); }
.nu-signal__top { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-signal__status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.nu-signal__status i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--nulo-mint); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 28%, transparent); }
.nu-signal__beams { position: absolute; inset: 18% 12% 15%; display: grid; place-items: center; transform: rotate(-10deg); }
.nu-signal__beam { position: absolute; width: 72%; height: 1px; background: var(--nulo-ink); transform-origin: left; opacity: .55; }
.nu-signal__beam:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(-17deg); }
.nu-signal__beam:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(13deg); }
.nu-signal__beam:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(41deg); width: 54%; }
.nu-signal__lens { position: relative; width: min(46%, 210px); aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid var(--nulo-ink); border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 38% 32%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 68%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-peach) 52%, transparent) 48%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 12%, transparent)); box-shadow: 14px 16px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 44%, transparent); animation: nu-breathe 5.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.nu-signal__lens::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 22%; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; }
.nu-signal__readings { position: absolute; left: 24px; right: 24px; bottom: 22px; z-index: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; }
.nu-reading { border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 24%, transparent); padding-top: 10px; }
.nu-reading span { display: block; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 55%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-reading strong { display: block; margin-top: 5px; font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.06em; }

.nu-frames { background: var(--nulo-paper); }
.nu-frame-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 18px; }
.nu-frame-card { position: relative; min-height: 440px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 16%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px; overflow: hidden; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 68%, transparent); transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-out), background var(--dur-nulo-base) ease, border-color var(--dur-nulo-base) ease; }
.nu-frame-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 24%, transparent), transparent 42%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--dur-nulo-base) ease; }
.nu-frame-card:hover, .nu-frame-card:focus-within { transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(-.7deg); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 38%, transparent); }
.nu-frame-card:hover::before, .nu-frame-card:focus-within::before { opacity: 1; }
.nu-frame-card:nth-child(2)::before { background: linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-peach) 24%, transparent), transparent 42%); }
.nu-frame-card:nth-child(3)::before { background: linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 26%, transparent), transparent 42%); }
.nu-frame-card__top, .nu-frame-card__bottom { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.nu-frame-card__top { align-items: flex-start; }
.nu-frame-card__index { font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.nu-frame-card__tag { padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 38%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-frame-card:nth-child(2) .nu-frame-card__tag { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-peach) 50%, transparent); }
.nu-frame-card:nth-child(3) .nu-frame-card__tag { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 48%, transparent); }
.nu-frame-card__art { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 280px; perspective: 700px; }
.nu-frame-card__art::before { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 74%; height: 26%; bottom: 18%; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 10%, transparent); filter: blur(13px); transform: rotate(-7deg); }
.nu-frame-card__frame { position: relative; width: 68%; aspect-ratio: 1.65; border: 5px solid var(--nulo-ink); border-radius: 42% 42% 35% 35%; transform: rotate(-6deg) rotateY(-8deg); transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-slow) var(--ease-nulo-spring); }
.nu-frame-card__frame::before, .nu-frame-card__frame::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 18%; width: 39%; height: 58%; border: 2px solid var(--nulo-ink); border-radius: 48% 48% 40% 40%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 35%, transparent); }
.nu-frame-card__frame::before { left: 5%; }
.nu-frame-card__frame::after { right: 5%; }
.nu-frame-card:nth-child(2) .nu-frame-card__frame { border-radius: 28% 28% 40% 40%; transform: rotate(4deg) rotateY(8deg); }
.nu-frame-card:nth-child(2) .nu-frame-card__frame::before, .nu-frame-card:nth-child(2) .nu-frame-card__frame::after { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-peach) 44%, transparent); border-radius: 36%; }
.nu-frame-card:nth-child(3) .nu-frame-card__frame { width: 62%; aspect-ratio: 1.9; border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(-3deg); }
.nu-frame-card:nth-child(3) .nu-frame-card__frame::before, .nu-frame-card:nth-child(3) .nu-frame-card__frame::after { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 45%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; }
.nu-frame-card:hover .nu-frame-card__frame, .nu-frame-card:focus-within .nu-frame-card__frame { transform: rotate(0) rotateY(0) translateY(-6px) scale(1.04); }
.nu-frame-card__bottom { align-items: flex-end; }
.nu-frame-card__name { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: 31px; letter-spacing: -.08em; font-weight: 500; }
.nu-frame-card__meta { margin: 6px 0 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 58%, transparent); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; }
.nu-frame-card__link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; border: 0; padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--nulo-ink); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-frame-card__link span { transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-fast) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-frame-card__link:hover span, .nu-frame-card__link:focus-visible span { transform: translateX(4px); }

.nu-materials { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 19%, var(--nulo-paper)); }
.nu-materials__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(300px, .9fr) minmax(420px, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(44px, 8vw, 130px); align-items: center; }
.nu-materials__stack { position: relative; min-height: 500px; display: grid; place-items: center; perspective: 1000px; }
.nu-material-layer { position: absolute; width: min(380px, 65%); aspect-ratio: 1.35; border: 1px solid var(--nulo-ink); border-radius: 18px; display: grid; align-content: end; padding: 18px; box-shadow: 15px 18px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 9%, transparent); transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-slow) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-material-layer:nth-child(1) { transform: translate(-22px, -70px) rotate(-8deg); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 62%, var(--nulo-paper)); }
.nu-material-layer:nth-child(2) { transform: translate(18px, 0) rotate(5deg); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-peach) 62%, var(--nulo-paper)); }
.nu-material-layer:nth-child(3) { transform: translate(-8px, 78px) rotate(-2deg); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 66%, var(--nulo-paper)); }
.nu-materials__stack:hover .nu-material-layer:nth-child(1) { transform: translate(-72px, -98px) rotate(-12deg); }
.nu-materials__stack:hover .nu-material-layer:nth-child(2) { transform: translate(60px, -2px) rotate(8deg); }
.nu-materials__stack:hover .nu-material-layer:nth-child(3) { transform: translate(-18px, 100px) rotate(-4deg); }
.nu-material-layer__code { font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.nu-material-layer__name { margin-top: 8px; font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px); letter-spacing: -.08em; }
.nu-material-layer__line { position: absolute; left: 18px; top: 18px; width: 42px; height: 1px; background: var(--nulo-ink); }
.nu-materials__copy h2 { max-width: 570px; margin: 16px 0 24px; font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: clamp(40px, 5.3vw, 79px); line-height: .95; letter-spacing: -.08em; font-weight: 500; }
.nu-materials__copy p { max-width: 440px; margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 68%, transparent); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; }
.nu-materials__specs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-top: 32px; }
.nu-spec { border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 27%, transparent); padding-top: 11px; }
.nu-spec__code { display: block; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.nu-spec__value { display: block; margin-top: 7px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; }

.nu-protocol { background: var(--nulo-paper); }
.nu-protocol__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px; }
.nu-protocol-card { position: relative; min-height: 276px; border-top: 1px solid var(--nulo-ink); padding: 20px 0 0; transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-base) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-protocol-card:hover, .nu-protocol-card:focus-within { transform: translateY(-6px); }
.nu-protocol-card__number { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 35px; height: 35px; border: 1px solid var(--nulo-ink); border-radius: 50%; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; }
.nu-protocol-card h3 { max-width: 230px; margin: 42px 0 13px; font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: clamp(25px, 3vw, 39px); line-height: .98; letter-spacing: -.08em; font-weight: 500; }
.nu-protocol-card p { max-width: 260px; margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 62%, transparent); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; }
.nu-protocol-card__metric { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 0; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 48%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-protocol-card:nth-child(2) .nu-protocol-card__metric { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-peach) 54%, transparent); }
.nu-protocol-card:nth-child(3) .nu-protocol-card__metric { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 55%, transparent); }
.nu-protocol-card__rule { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 24px; width: 62%; height: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 22%, transparent); transform-origin: left; transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-slow) var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-protocol-card:hover .nu-protocol-card__rule { transform: scaleX(.45); }

.nu-fitting { position: relative; color: var(--nulo-paper); background: var(--nulo-ink); overflow: clip; }
.nu-fitting::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 520px; aspect-ratio: 1; right: -130px; top: 15%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 55%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 28px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 12%, transparent), 0 0 0 58px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 9%, transparent); transform: rotate(calc(var(--nu-scroll) * -8deg)); pointer-events: none; }
.nu-fitting__grid { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, .8fr) minmax(420px, 1.2fr); gap: clamp(44px, 8vw, 130px); align-items: start; }
.nu-fitting__copy h2 { max-width: 520px; margin: 16px 0 22px; font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: clamp(43px, 6vw, 88px); line-height: .93; letter-spacing: -.08em; font-weight: 500; }
.nu-fitting__copy p { max-width: 360px; margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 64%, transparent); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; }
.nu-fitting__facts { display: grid; gap: 14px; margin-top: 38px; }
.nu-fitting__fact { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 76px 1fr; gap: 15px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 22%, transparent); padding-top: 11px; }
.nu-fitting__fact strong { font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.08em; }
.nu-fitting__fact span { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 62%, transparent); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; }
.nu-form-card { position: relative; border-radius: 14px; padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 42px); color: var(--nulo-ink); background: var(--nulo-paper); box-shadow: 16px 20px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 28%, transparent); }
.nu-form-card[data-phase="success"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-mint) 72%, var(--nulo-paper)); }
.nu-form-card__top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.nu-form-card__title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: 25px; letter-spacing: -.07em; font-weight: 500; }
.nu-form-card__code { padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 18%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-form { display: grid; gap: 16px; }
.nu-form__row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.nu-field { position: relative; }
.nu-field label { position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 14px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 52%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .04em; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: left top; transition: transform var(--dur-nulo-fast) var(--ease-nulo-out), color var(--dur-nulo-fast) ease; }
.nu-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 20%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; outline: 0; padding: 21px 13px 9px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 70%, var(--nulo-lilac)); color: var(--nulo-ink); font-size: 13px; transition: border-color var(--dur-nulo-fast) ease, box-shadow var(--dur-nulo-fast) ease, background var(--dur-nulo-fast) ease; }
.nu-input:focus { border-color: var(--nulo-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-peach) 42%, transparent); background: var(--nulo-paper); }
.nu-input:not(:placeholder-shown) + label, .nu-input:focus + label, .nu-field[data-filled="true"] label { transform: translateY(-7px) scale(.72); color: var(--nulo-ink); }
select.nu-input { appearance: none; padding-right: 34px; }
.nu-field--select::after { content: "⌄"; position: absolute; right: 14px; top: 14px; pointer-events: none; }
.nu-input--area { min-height: 104px; resize: vertical; }
.nu-field__error { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--nulo-peach); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; }
.nu-form__legend { margin: 3px 0 7px; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-choice-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
.nu-choice { position: relative; }
.nu-choice input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.nu-choice span { display: block; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 17%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; padding: 11px 9px; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background var(--dur-fast) ease, border-color var(--dur-fast) ease, transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-nulo-spring); }
.nu-choice input:checked + span { border-color: var(--nulo-ink); background: var(--nulo-peach); }
.nu-choice input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--nulo-peach); outline-offset: 3px; }
.nu-choice:active span { transform: scale(.97); }
.nu-fieldset { margin: 0; border: 0; padding: 0; }
.nu-form__count { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 10px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 48%, transparent); font-size: 8px; }
.nu-form[data-shake="1"] .nu-input[aria-invalid="true"] { animation: nu-shake 360ms var(--ease-nulo-out); }
.nu-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.nu-placeholder { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 180px; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 28%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-lilac) 22%, transparent); }
.nu-form__submit { width: 100%; margin-top: 3px; }
.nu-form__submit::before { background: var(--nulo-mint); }
.nu-form__busy { display: none; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.nu-form__busy i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; animation: nu-dot 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
.nu-form__busy i:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 100ms; }
.nu-form__busy i:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 200ms; }
.nu-form__submit[data-loading="true"] .nu-form__submit-label { display: none; }
.nu-form__submit[data-loading="true"] .nu-form__busy { display: inline-flex; }
.nu-form__fine { margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-ink) 53%, transparent); text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.nu-success { display: grid; justify-items: start; gap: 16px; min-height: 380px; align-content: center; }
.nu-success__stamp { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 92px; height: 92px; border: 2px solid var(--nulo-ink); border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(-9deg); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .11em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-success__code { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .12em; }
.nu-success h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-dm-mono), monospace; font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 56px); letter-spacing: -.08em; font-weight: 500; }
.nu-success p { max-width: 390px; margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }
.nu-success .nu-button { min-height: 42px; }

.nu-footer { position: relative; padding: 62px 0 30px; color: var(--nulo-paper); background: var(--nulo-ink); }
.nu-footer__top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 34px; padding-bottom: 70px; }
.nu-footer .nu-logo { color: var(--nulo-paper); }
.nu-footer .nu-logo__mark { color: var(--nulo-paper); }
.nu-footer__tag { max-width: 250px; margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 62%, transparent); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; }
.nu-footer__links { display: flex; gap: 28px; }
.nu-footer__link { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 72%, transparent); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nu-footer__link:hover, .nu-footer__link:focus-visible { color: var(--nulo-peach); }
.nu-footer__bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 22px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 18%, transparent); padding-top: 15px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nulo-paper) 46%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

    <file path="src/app/(nulo)/nulo/calibration/CalibrationDial.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CALIBRATION_MODES, focusState, modeAt, snapAngle, type CalibrationMode } from "./geometry";

type DialVars = React.CSSProperties & { "--nu-angle"?: string; "--nu-aperture"?: number };

function angleFromPointer(event: PointerEvent | React.PointerEvent, element: HTMLElement): number {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = event.clientX - (rect.left + rect.width / 2);
  const y = event.clientY - (rect.top + rect.height / 2);
  return (Math.atan2(y, x) * 180) / Math.PI + 90;
}

export function CalibrationDial() {
  const dialRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const frameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const pendingRef = useRef(0);
  const draggingRef = useRef(false);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<CalibrationMode>("screen");
  const [angle, setAngle] = useState(0);
  const state = focusState(mode, angle);

  const writeLive = useCallback((nextAngle: number) => {
    const element = dialRef.current;
    if (!element) return;
    const liveMode = modeAt(nextAngle);
    const live = focusState(liveMode, nextAngle);
    element.style.setProperty("--nu-angle", `${live.rotation}deg`);
    element.style.setProperty("--nu-aperture", String(live.aperture));
    element.dataset.dragMode = liveMode;
  }, []);

  const scheduleLive = (nextAngle: number) => {
    pendingRef.current = nextAngle;
    if (frameRef.current !== null) return;
    frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      frameRef.current = null;
      writeLive(pendingRef.current);
    });
  };

  const commit = (rawAngle: number) => {
    const nextAngle = snapAngle(rawAngle);
    const nextMode = modeAt(nextAngle);
    setAngle(nextAngle);
    setMode(nextMode);
    writeLive(nextAngle);
  };

  const onPointerDown = (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    draggingRef.current = true;
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    scheduleLive(angleFromPointer(event, event.currentTarget));
  };

  const onPointerMove = (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!draggingRef.current) return;
    scheduleLive(angleFromPointer(event, event.currentTarget));
  };

  const onPointerUp = (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!draggingRef.current) return;
    draggingRef.current = false;
    const raw = angleFromPointer(event, event.currentTarget);
    commit(raw);
    event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  };

  const chooseMode = (nextMode: CalibrationMode) => {
    const marker = CALIBRATION_MODES.find((item) => item.id === nextMode)?.marker ?? 0;
    setMode(nextMode);
    setAngle(marker);
    writeLive(marker);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight" && event.key !== "Home" && event.key !== "End") return;
    event.preventDefault();
    if (event.key === "Home") return chooseMode("screen");
    if (event.key === "End") return chooseMode("night");
    const direction = event.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1;
    commit(angle + direction * 15);
  };

  const style: DialVars = { "--nu-angle": `${state.rotation}deg`, "--nu-aperture": state.aperture };

  return (
    <div className="nu-dial" ref={dialRef} style={style} role="slider" tabIndex={0} aria-label="Calibration focus dial" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={360} aria-valuenow={state.rotation} aria-valuetext={`${state.mode} calibration`} onPointerDown={onPointerDown} onPointerMove={onPointerMove} onPointerUp={onPointerUp} onPointerCancel={onPointerUp} onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
      <div className="nu-dial__shadow" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="nu-dial__face" aria-hidden="true">
        <div className="nu-dial__ticks" />
        <div className="nu-dial__ring" />
        <div className="nu-dial__lens"><div className="nu-dial__crosshair" /></div>
        <div className="nu-dial__readout"><strong>{state.mode}</strong><span>{Math.round(state.transmission * 100)}% light</span></div>
      </div>
      <span className="nu-dial__hint">drag / ← →</span>
      <div className="nu-dial__mode-buttons" role="group" aria-label="Choose calibration mode">
        {CALIBRATION_MODES.map((item) => (
          <button key={item.id} type="button" className="nu-mode-button" aria-pressed={mode === item.id} onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); chooseMode(item.id); }}>
            {item.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(nulo)/nulo/calibration/geometry.ts">
<![CDATA[export type CalibrationMode = "screen" | "street" | "night";

export type FocusState = {
  mode: CalibrationMode;
  aperture: number;
  transmission: number;
  rotation: number;
  tint: "lilac" | "peach" | "mint";
};

const MODE_ORDER: CalibrationMode[] = ["screen", "street", "night"];

const MODE_VALUES: Record<CalibrationMode, Omit<FocusState, "mode" | "rotation">> = {
  screen: { aperture: 0.58, transmission: 0.78, tint: "lilac" },
  street: { aperture: 0.72, transmission: 0.92, tint: "peach" },
  night: { aperture: 0.34, transmission: 0.64, tint: "mint" },
};

export function normalizeAngle(angle: number): number {
  return ((angle % 360) + 360) % 360;
}

export function modeAt(angle: number): CalibrationMode {
  const normalized = normalizeAngle(angle);
  return MODE_ORDER[Math.floor(normalized / 120)] ?? "screen";
}

export function snapAngle(angle: number): number {
  const normalized = normalizeAngle(angle);
  const snap = Math.round(normalized / 120) * 120;
  return snap === 360 ? 0 : snap;
}

export function focusState(mode: CalibrationMode, angle: number): FocusState {
  return { mode, rotation: normalizeAngle(angle), ...MODE_VALUES[mode] };
}

export function modeIndex(mode: CalibrationMode): number {
  return MODE_ORDER.indexOf(mode);
}

export const CALIBRATION_MODES = MODE_ORDER.map((mode) => ({
  id: mode,
  label: mode === "screen" ? "Screen" : mode === "street" ? "Street" : "Night",
  note: mode === "screen" ? "low glare" : mode === "street" ? "true colour" : "edge lift",
  marker: modeIndex(mode) * 120,
})) as ReadonlyArray<{ id: CalibrationMode; label: string; note: string; marker: number }>;
]]>
    </file>

    <file path="src/app/(nulo)/nulo/forms/fitting.ts">
<![CDATA[export type FittingInput = {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  reason: string;
  frame: string;
  note: string;
};

export type FittingField = keyof FittingInput;
export type FittingErrors = Partial<Record<FittingField, string>>;

export const FITTING_REASONS = ["Screen work", "City days", "Night driving"] as const;
export const FITTING_FRAMES = ["Arc 01", "Fold 02", "Halo 03"] as const;
export const NOTE_MAX = 240;

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;

export function validateFitting(input: FittingInput): FittingErrors {
  const errors: FittingErrors = {};
  if (input.name.trim().length < 2) errors.name = "Add your name.";
  if (!EMAIL.test(input.email.trim())) errors.email = "Add a working email.";
  if (!FITTING_REASONS.includes(input.reason as (typeof FITTING_REASONS)[number])) errors.reason = "Choose a day mode.";
  if (!FITTING_FRAMES.includes(input.frame as (typeof FITTING_FRAMES)[number])) errors.frame = "Choose a frame.";
  if (input.note.length > NOTE_MAX) errors.note = `Keep the note to ${NOTE_MAX} characters.`;
  return errors;
}

export function isValid(errors: FittingErrors): boolean {
  return Object.keys(errors).length === 0;
}

function hash(text: string): number {
  let h = 5381;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += 1) h = (Math.imul(h, 33) ^ text.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return h;
}

export function frameReference(input: FittingInput): string {
  const code = hash(`${input.name.trim().toLowerCase()}|${input.email.trim().toLowerCase()}|${input.frame}`)
    .toString(36)
    .toUpperCase()
    .padStart(4, "0")
    .slice(-4);
  return `NU-${code}`;
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { FITTING_FRAMES, FITTING_REASONS, frameReference, isValid, NOTE_MAX, validateFitting, type FittingErrors, type FittingField, type FittingInput } from "./fitting";

type Phase = "idle" | "loading" | "success";
const ORDER: FittingField[] = ["name", "email", "reason", "frame", "note"];
const INITIAL: FittingInput = { name: "", email: "", reason: "Screen work", frame: "Arc 01", note: "" };

export function FittingForm() {
  const uid = useId();
  const [values, setValues] = useState<FittingInput>(INITIAL);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<FittingErrors>({});
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>("idle");
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [shake, setShake] = useState(0);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const successRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const set = (field: FittingField, value: string) => {
    const next = { ...values, [field]: value };
    setValues(next);
    if (submitted) setErrors(validateFitting(next));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const onFrameClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      const trigger = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>("[data-frame]");
      const label = trigger?.dataset.frame;
      if (!label || !FITTING_FRAMES.includes(label as (typeof FITTING_FRAMES)[number])) return;
      set("frame", label);
    };
    document.addEventListener("click", onFrameClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("click", onFrameClick);
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase === "success") successRef.current?.focus();
  }, [phase]);

  const errorId = (field: FittingField) => (errors[field] ? `${uid}-${field}-error` : undefined);
  const onSubmit = (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (phase === "loading") return;
    setSubmitted(true);
    const nextErrors = validateFitting(values);
    setErrors(nextErrors);
    if (!isValid(nextErrors)) {
      setShake((value) => value + 1);
      const first = ORDER.find((field) => nextErrors[field]);
      if (first) formRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[name="${first}"]`)?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setPhase("loading");
    const duration = document.documentElement.dataset.nuloMotion === "live" ? 1100 : 180;
    window.setTimeout(() => setPhase("success"), duration);
  };

  const reset = () => {
    setValues(INITIAL);
    setErrors({});
    setSubmitted(false);
    setPhase("idle");
  };

  return (
    <div className="nu-form-card" data-phase={phase}>
      {phase !== "success" ? (
        <form ref={formRef} className="nu-form" noValidate onSubmit={onSubmit} data-shake={shake % 2}>
          <div className="nu-form-card__top"><h3 className="nu-form-card__title">Request a fitting</h3><span className="nu-form-card__code">NU / intake</span></div>
          <div className="nu-form__row">
            <div className="nu-field" data-filled={values.name ? "true" : "false"}>
              <input id={`${uid}-name`} name="name" className="nu-input" placeholder=" " autoComplete="name" value={values.name} aria-invalid={!!errors.name} aria-describedby={errorId("name")} onChange={(event) => set("name", event.target.value)} />
              <label htmlFor={`${uid}-name`}>Your name</label>
              {errors.name && <p className="nu-field__error" id={errorId("name")} role="alert">{errors.name}</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="nu-field" data-filled={values.email ? "true" : "false"}>
              <input id={`${uid}-email`} name="email" type="email" className="nu-input" placeholder=" " autoComplete="email" value={values.email} aria-invalid={!!errors.email} aria-describedby={errorId("email")} onChange={(event) => set("email", event.target.value)} />
              <label htmlFor={`${uid}-email`}>Email</label>
              {errors.email && <p className="nu-field__error" id={errorId("email")} role="alert">{errors.email}</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="nu-field nu-field--select" data-filled="true">
            <select id={`${uid}-reason`} name="reason" className="nu-input" value={values.reason} aria-invalid={!!errors.reason} aria-describedby={errorId("reason")} onChange={(event) => set("reason", event.target.value)}>
              {FITTING_REASONS.map((reason) => <option key={reason} value={reason}>{reason}</option>)}
            </select>
            <label htmlFor={`${uid}-reason`}>Your main mode</label>
            {errors.reason && <p className="nu-field__error" id={errorId("reason")} role="alert">{errors.reason}</p>}
          </div>
          <fieldset className="nu-fieldset" aria-describedby={errorId("frame")}>
            <legend className="nu-form__legend">First frame</legend>
            <div className="nu-choice-row">
              {FITTING_FRAMES.map((frame) => <label className="nu-choice" key={frame}><input type="radio" name="frame" value={frame} checked={values.frame === frame} onChange={() => set("frame", frame)} /><span>{frame}</span></label>)}
            </div>
            {errors.frame && <p className="nu-field__error" id={errorId("frame")} role="alert">{errors.frame}</p>}
          </fieldset>
          <div className="nu-field" data-filled={values.note ? "true" : "false"}>
            <textarea id={`${uid}-note`} name="note" className="nu-input nu-input--area" placeholder=" " rows={3} maxLength={NOTE_MAX + 20} value={values.note} aria-invalid={!!errors.note} aria-describedby={errorId("note")} onChange={(event) => set("note", event.target.value)} />
            <label htmlFor={`${uid}-note`}>What should we tune? (optional)</label>
            <span className="nu-form__count nu-mono" aria-hidden="true">{values.note.length}/{NOTE_MAX}</span>
            {errors.note && <p className="nu-field__error" id={errorId("note")} role="alert">{errors.note}</p>}
          </div>
          <button type="submit" className="nu-button nu-button--dark nu-form__submit" data-loading={phase === "loading"} disabled={phase === "loading"}><span className="nu-form__submit-label">Send the request <span className="nu-button__arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></span><span className="nu-form__busy" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></span><span className="nu-sr-only" aria-live="polite">{phase === "loading" ? "Sending request" : ""}</span></button>
          <p className="nu-form__fine">No account. No pressure. Just a measured reply.</p>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <div ref={successRef} className="nu-success" tabIndex={-1} role="status">
          <span className="nu-success__stamp">calibrated<br />for reply</span>
          <p className="nu-success__code">reference / {frameReference(values)}</p>
          <h3>We’ve got the signal.</h3>
          <p>Thanks, {values.name.trim() || "there"}. NULO will send a first frame suggestion to {values.email.trim() || "your inbox"} within 48 hours.</p>
          <button className="nu-button nu-button--ghost" type="button" onClick={reset}><span>Start another</span></button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(nulo)/nulo/motion/math.ts">
<![CDATA[export function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
}

export function lerp(from: number, to: number, t: number): number {
  return from + (to - from) * t;
}

export function progress(value: number, start: number, end: number): number {
  if (end <= start) return value >= end ? 1 : 0;
  return clamp((value - start) / (end - start), 0, 1);
}

export function staggerDelay(index: number, step: number, cap: number): number {
  return Math.min(index * step, cap);
}

export function tiltAngles(x: number, y: number, max: number): { rx: number; ry: number } {
  const ry = (clamp(x, 0, 1) - 0.5) * 2 * max;
  const rx = (0.5 - clamp(y, 0, 1)) * 2 * max;
  return { rx: rx + 0, ry: ry + 0 };
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

export function Reveals() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (document.documentElement.dataset.nuloMotion !== "live") return;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
          (entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.nuIn = "true";
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        });
      },
      { rootMargin: "0px 0px -10% 0px", threshold: 0.08 },
    );
    document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-nu-reveal]:not([data-nu-in='true'])").forEach((node) => io.observe(node));
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return null;
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(nulo)/nulo/motion/ScrollVars.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { progress } from "./math";

export function ScrollVars() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (document.documentElement.dataset.nuloMotion !== "live") return;
    const root = document.documentElement;
    let raf = 0;
    const frame = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const max = Math.max(1, document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
      const value = progress(window.scrollY, 0, max);
      root.style.setProperty("--nu-scroll", value.toFixed(4));
      root.style.setProperty("--nu-progress", `${Math.round(value * 100)}%`);
    };
    const schedule = () => {
      if (!raf) raf = window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
    frame();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", schedule, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
    };
  }, []);
  return null;
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(nulo)/nulo/motion/SmoothScroll.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { canHoverFinely, reducedMotion } from "./useReducedMotion";

type LenisLike = { raf: (time: number) => void; destroy: () => void; scrollTo: (target: HTMLElement | string, options?: Record<string, unknown>) => void };

declare global {
  interface Window {
    __nuloLenis?: LenisLike;
  }
}

const ease = (t: number) => (t === 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t));

export function SmoothScroll() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reducedMotion() || !canHoverFinely() || document.documentElement.dataset.nuloMotion !== "live") return;
    let lenis: LenisLike | null = null;
    let raf = 0;
    let cancelled = false;
    import("lenis").then(({ default: Lenis }) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1, smoothWheel: true }) as unknown as LenisLike;
      window.__nuloLenis = lenis;
      const loop = (time: number) => {
        lenis?.raf(time);
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      };
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    });
    const onClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      const anchor = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLAnchorElement>('a[href^="#"]');
      if (!anchor || !lenis) return;
      const id = anchor.getAttribute("href")?.slice(1);
      if (!id) return;
      const target = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!target) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: -80, duration: 1.15, easing: ease });
    };
    document.addEventListener("click", onClick);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      document.removeEventListener("click", onClick);
      lenis?.destroy();
      delete window.__nuloLenis;
    };
  }, []);
  return null;
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(nulo)/nulo/motion/useReducedMotion.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

export function canHoverFinely(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches;
}

export function reducedMotion(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
}
